summary: MSC Income Fund filed an 8-K announcing a CEO succession plan approved by its board. Dwayne L. Hyzak, current Chairman and CEO since October 2020, will transition the CEO role to Nicholas T. Meserve, currently a Managing Director and private credit head, expected in Q4 2026. Hyzak will become Executive Chairman post-transition. No immediate appointment; Meserve's compensation is paid by the adviser, not the fund. No new compensatory arrangements were entered. This is a planned, orderly succession, not a forced departure. Watch for the formal appointment and any proxy statement updates.
